description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary for {0}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Impact Tremors.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Impact Tremors trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand.
Repeat.
